title: Mysterious jungle sickness and deafness at Tikal
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Mysterious jungle sickness and deafness at Tikal, about 2024 at Tikal, Guatemala, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I was 75% deaf in each ear by the end of the trip.

plain: Luke Caverns, a researcher who studies ancient pyramids, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that on a 2024 trip to Tikal, the ruins of an ancient Maya city in the Guatemalan jungle, he came down with a mysterious illness. He says that by the end of the trip he had lost about 75 percent of the hearing in each ear.
